(i.e. indexed ethernet switch is not available) ETHSWT_PORT_MIRRORING_CONFIGURATION_NOT_ SUPPORTED: port mirroring configuration is not supported by Ethernet switch driver or by the Ethernet switch hardware Description Store the given port mirror configuration in a shadow buffer in the Ethernet switch driver for the given MirroredSwitchIdx. Available via EthSwt.h
